## Think About It

1. What makes a storm form over the ocean? (Cool air pushing down on warm wet air — pressure drops.) 2. How do people know a storm is coming? (Clouds gather, air feels heavy, white caps form.) 3. Find words with suffixes. (coastal, passing, gathering, morning.)
